title: Why your GPS needs Einstein
summary: GPS satellite clocks are built deliberately wrong so relativity makes them right.

title: Why honey never spoils
summary: Honey outlasts empires because it is a sealed desert too dry, too acidic, and too antiseptic for microbes to survive.

title: Why the microwave doesn't heat by resonance
summary: A microwave doesn't resonate water molecules; it twists them billions of times a second and the internal friction is the heat.

title: Why a bicycle stays up
summary: The gyroscope explanation for bicycle stability is wrong, and the real answer is one condition that several different mechanisms can satisfy.

title: The machine that seems to break physics
summary: A heat pump gives out three or four times the energy it uses because it moves heat instead of making it, and your refrigerator is the same machine pointed the other way.
